faq.title: Frequently asked questions.
faq.description: Quick answers to help you plan your stay in Madurai.

items.question: How far is MRS Residency from Meenakshi Amman Temple?
items.answer: MRS Residency is approximately an 8-minute walk from Meenakshi Amman Temple.

items.question: How far is the hotel from Madurai Junction?
items.answer: Madurai Junction railway station is approximately a 7-minute walk from the hotel.

items.question: Does MRS Residency have AC and non-AC rooms?
items.answer: Yes. Guests can choose from deluxe and non-deluxe rooms in both AC and non-AC options.

items.question: What are the check-in and check-out times?
items.answer: Check-in is from 12:15 PM and check-out is by 12:00 PM.

items.question: How can I book a room?
items.answer: You can book online, call +91 79046 68686, or contact the hotel through WhatsApp to check availability.
